name: brandkit-mcp

tools.name: get_brand_overview
tools.description: High-level overview of the brand atomic system: brand name, magic_trick presence, inventory counts, contexts, and the full v2 tool list.

tools.name: get_magic_trick
tools.description: Return the human-authored magic_trick.md taste primer verbatim. This file is human-write-only — never write to it via any tool.

tools.name: get_positioning
tools.description: Return the brand's positioning document (agent/verbal/positioning.md). Includes a taste primer from magic_trick.md.

tools.name: get_audience
tools.description: Return the brand's audience definition parsed from agent/verbal/audience.yaml. Freeform YAML; returned as-is. Includes a taste primer.

tools.name: get_messaging
tools.description: Return the brand's messaging document (agent/verbal/messaging.md). Includes a taste primer.

tools.name: get_differentiation
tools.description: Return the brand's differentiation document (agent/verbal/differentiation.md). Includes a taste primer.

tools.name: get_concepts
tools.description: Return the brand's creative concepts/directions (agent/verbal/concepts.md). Includes a taste primer.

tools.name: get_voice
tools.description: Return the brand's voice document (agent/verbal/voice.md). Includes a taste primer.

tools.name: get_colors_and_type
tools.description: Return colors and typography as CSS custom properties from agent/visual/colors_and_type.css (with optional artifact override).

tools.name: get_assets
tools.description: Return logos and other binary assets from agent/visual/assets/. Replaces v1 get_logos + get_textures.

tools.name: get_fonts
tools.description: Return font faces declared in agent/visual/fonts/ (binary files + optional fonts.yaml manifest).

tools.name: get_components
tools.description: Return UI component specifications from agent/visual/components/. Optionally filtered by context (base | web | product).

name.description: Filter to a single component by name

tools.name: get_tokens
tools.description: Return design tokens from agent/visual/tokens/ specimens. Optional context (base|web|product) and output format (json|css|scss|tailwind|w3c).

type.description: Filter by token type (color, font, radius, spacing, etc.)

tools.name: get_motion
tools.description: Return the motion system: parsed motion.json tokens + motion.css text.

tools.name: get_css
tools.description: Return raw CSS text from agent/visual/colors_and_type.css and agent/visual/motion/motion.css for the requested context.

tools.name: search_brand
tools.description: Full-text search across all brand atomic system content: verbal docs, magic_trick, components, tokens, assets, and CSS files.

tools.name: validate_usage
tools.description: Validate that an HTML/CSS snippet uses brand tokens (rather than literal values) and references known components.

snippet.description: HTML or CSS snippet to validate

tools.name: get_context_diff
tools.description: Diff two contexts (base | web | product) across colors_and_type custom properties, components, and tokens.
